title: Take Me To A Better Place
You don’t get to define me
description: A song about empowerment and reclaiming ownership of my life, reminding others that my path is mine alone. In the end, no one gets to define who you are, because your life belongs to you.
lyrics:
you dont get to define me

You studied me like broken language
Like I was something to explain
Spoke in cold and borrowed answers
Never touched an ounce of pain

Every mirror held a stranger
Every birthday felt like loss
Learned to hide inside the silence
Learned exactly what it costs

You only saw the smoke
Never where the fire began

I am not your war to fight
Not your fear to weaponize
Not a target for your anger
Just because I chose my life

I bled to become this person
Through every scar you left behind
Say whatever helps you sleep
You don’t get to define me

you dont get to define me

You disguise contempt as concern
Wrap your cruelty up as care
Never seeing what your words do
Never feeling what lives there

How many break behind closed doorways
Trying hard to just survive?
How many learn to hate their breathing
Just to keep your world alive?

Your black-and-white world never fit
A heart that had to fight to live

I am not your war to fight
Not your fear to weaponize
Not a target for your anger
Just because I chose my life

I bled to become this person
Through every scar you left behind
Say whatever helps you sleep
You don’t get to define me

you dont get to define me

There were nights I begged for silence
Thought disappearing meant relief
But the voice beneath the wreckage
Still refused to leave me

I AM NOT YOUR WAR TO FIGHT
NOT YOUR FEAR TO WEAPONIZE
I SURVIVED YOUR EXPECTATIONS
AND I CAME OUT ALIVE

I bled to become this person
I won’t disappear this time
Say whatever helps you sleep
You don’t get to define me

you dont get to define me

title: Endless Scream
description: A song about the long-term effects of torture, inspired by an idea I originally developed into a poem.
lyrics:
Can you hear it...
Still screaming...

Beneath the weight of fractured skies
I felt the end behind my eyes
A thousand sparks beneath my skin
Like something vile was crawling in

The seconds twisted out of shape
No waking from this screaming state
A single breath became a war
A moment stretched forevermore

The ceiling cracked, the shadows bent
Reality was torn and spent
The hands of time refused to move
Yet every nerve had more to prove

The darkness pressed against my chest
No mercy offered, no release, no rest
I begged the silence just to speak
But silence only watched me bleed

And every pulse became a knife
Carving deeper into life

I am the echo in the endless scream
A shattered ghost inside a dying dream
No dawn will rise, no light will call my name
I burn alive inside this endless flame

I hear the walls, I hear them breathing near
A thousand voices feeding on my fear
No peace remains, no ending left to claim
I am the echo in the endless scream

The hours melted into black
No sense of forward, no way back
My body trembled thread by thread
Half alive and mostly dead

The nerves ignited one by one
Like dying stars that came undone
Electric agony in waves
A prison made beneath my veins

The mirror showed a thing unknown
A hollow shell of twitch and bone
No face I knew was staring through
Just something pain had molded to

I tried to speak but lost the sound
My voice collapsed into the ground
Still somewhere buried deep inside
A fractured part of me still cried

And every breath became a chain
Dragging me through endless pain

I am the echo in the endless scream
A shattered ghost inside a dying dream
No dawn will rise, no light will call my name
I burn alive inside this endless flame

I hear the walls, I hear them breathing near
A thousand voices feeding on my fear
No peace remains, no ending left to claim
I am the echo in the endless scream

Did time forget me here
Or was I never real
Was I a soul to save
Or something built to feel

Now every nerve is singing
Every vein is howling
Every memory dissolving
Every shadow crawling

I am the echo in the endless scream
The last reflection of what I used to be
No dawn will rise, no hands will pull me free
This cage of flesh was never meant to heal me

I hear the walls, I hear eternity
The sound of something feeding deep in me
No death will come, no final mercy seen
Forever trapped inside the endless scream

Still breathing...
Still screaming...

Still...
screaming...

title: Will It Be Worth It
description: This song is a callout to those who support political movements and parties that actively harm vulnerable people while dismissing the human cost. It asks a simple but painful question: what was the price of that support, and was it ever truly worth it? For those whose rights, safety, and futures are treated as bargaining chips, the damage is never theoretical.
lyrics:
Will it be worth it...
Will it be worth it...

A headline flickers across the screen
Another promise sold as something clean
Cheaper living, cheaper lies
While fear is burning in our eyes

A few more dollars in a shopping cart
But ripped apart another beating heart
Trans kids learning how to hide their names
While strangers cheer political games

Will it be worth it when the silence screams
When freedom dies inside abandoned dreams
When all the ones you swore you’d never break
Are crushed beneath the choices that you make

Will it be worth it when the damage shows
When history remembers who chose not to know
You saved a little while the world came undone
Tell me... was the bargain worth what we've become?

Tell me...
was the bargain worth what we've become?

Pages vanish from the classroom shelves
Truth gets buried to protect themselves
Voices silenced, stories burned away
Darkness dressed up as a safer day

The oceans rise beneath a poisoned sky
Children asking simply why
Smoke-filled lungs and summers set ablaze
Still we trade tomorrow for today's

Will it be worth it when the silence screams
When freedom dies inside abandoned dreams
When all the ones you swore you’d never break
Are crushed beneath the choices that you make

Will it be worth it when the damage shows
When history remembers who chose not to know
You saved a little while the world came undone
Tell me... was the bargain worth what we've become?

worth what we become

Women standing in a courtroom cold
Listening while ancient men take hold
Bodies treated like they’re not their own
Power speaking through a heart of stone

Hate gets louder marching through the streets
Wrapped in slogans, lies, and practiced speech
Neighbors turn while saying "not my fight"
As shadows swallow every ounce of light

And when the children ask us where we stood
Will "I wanted cheaper gas" sound good?
When names are written on memorial walls
Will comfort matter after freedom falls?

You watched the warning signs ignite
You saw the truth and killed the light
No price tag ever bought back souls
No empire built on hate survives the toll
survives the toll

Will it be worth it when the silence screams
When freedom dies inside abandoned dreams
When every fractured life becomes the cost
And all the things that mattered have been lost

Will it be worth it when the final page
Writes down our silence, cowardice, and rage
You gained so little while destroying everyone

Tell me...
WAS IT WORTH IT?!

Will it be worth it...
When there’s no one left to ask...

title: Every Thing Is Alright
description: A song about surviving hatred, betrayal, and pain while refusing to be broken by it. The lyrics follow a journey from resilience and self-discovery to open defiance, transforming emotional wounds into strength, unity, and resistance. It centers on perseverance, reclaiming identity, and standing unshaken against those who tried to silence or destroy you.
lyrics:
Now i know that everything is alright
In the end we will win this fight
Open your heart and let the silence scream
Hold onto hope and dare to chase the dream

Through every scar we found a reason to rise
Even through darkness we still reached for the skies
No more hiding from the truth we always knew
The fire inside is breaking brightly through

Scream it louder till the heavens shake
We are the ones that hatred could not break
Every wound became the armor that we wear
You tried to end us, but we're still standing here

Light up the night like a battle cry
We hit the ground but refused to die
From the ashes of the pain you left behind
We are relentless, we are undefined

They told us we were shadows passing by
Just fragile hearts too broken to survive
But every word they threw became our steel
And every scar became a way to heal

We took the pain and turned it into sound
A rising force that shakes the hollow ground
No force of hate can drag us to our knees
We are the storm, we are the reckoning breeze

Raise your voices till the skyline breaks
This is the sound that a revolution makes
Every chain you forged is turning into flame
You tried to silence us, remember our name

We walked through fire with our heads held high
Learned how to live when they left us to die
Turned every wound into a battle cry
Now watch us rise and lift the sky up high

Feel the thunder in the hearts you scarred
We became stronger from the battles fought
No more shadows, no more fading from the light
We are the ones who came prepared to fight

HEAR US SCREAM
FROM THE ROOF ABOVE
WE ARE NOT LEAVING
TIL THE WORLD SHOWS LOVE

NO MORE FEAR
NO MORE RUNNING AWAY
WE FOUGHT TOO LONG
TO BE SILENCED TODAY

SO HEAR OUR VOICES
ECHO THROUGH THE NIGHT
WE ARE STILL STANDING
AND WE WON THIS FIGHT

We are still standing...

And we won this fight

title: 7 songs in 7 days
description: Written as the final chapter of a personal seven songs in seven days challenge, this song captures the emotional weight of pushing through doubt, exhaustion, pain, and self-discovery to reach the finish line. Each verse reflects a different day of the journey, turning moments of struggle into music, until the final track becomes both a celebration of survival and a message to anyone fighting their own hard days: keep going.
lyrics:
Seven songs in seven days and here we are
Listen as my heart made it this far

Day one I made a song to take me away
Wish they could take me to a better place
Day two I was screaming the endless scream
With pain so deep it felt like a dream

By day three I took the journey to me
Where I showed my life 'til I was finally free
But every note kept pulling me ahead
Like stitching broken thoughts inside my head

Seven songs in seven days and here we are
Listen as my heart made it this far
No turning back today I'm here to stay
Cause I'm making seven songs in seven days

The reckoning has come
The challenge near complete
Still I fought my way
I turned my pain into seven songs in seven days

Day four came about for all to see
As I told the world you dont get to define me
Day five I asked the question that was best fit
I asked them all will it be worth it

Day six came exhaustion through the night
But I told the world everything is all right
Now here we are with 1 last song
Taking you through the journey of it all

Seven songs in seven days and here we are
Listen as my heart made it this far
No turning back today I'm here to stay
Cause I'm making seven songs in seven days

Now the fire has come
The challenge stands complete
Still I carved my way
Cause I turned my pain into seven songs in seven days

Seven days of pouring out my soul
Turning every fracture into something whole
Every sleepless night, every restless drive
Led me here somehow, still feeling alive

I was breaking just to build it up again
Found my voice somewhere beneath my skin
Every song a mirror, every line my name
By the end of this, I won’t be the same

So if you’ve been lost inside your own hard days
Counting down the hours just to find your way
This last note is proof I made it through
And if I can stand, then so can you

Seven songs, seven days, the story’s done
But the echoes of this fight have just begun
One last breath, one last chord to carry through
Seven songs in seven days… and I made it through

title: Let me be the Girl Inside
description: This song is simply about me wanting to be the girl I know I am inside.
lyrics:
let me be the girl inside...

let me be the girl inside

I know I speak too much about the pain I carry
Maybe people scroll away, maybe they grow weary
But silence never saved me when the darkness closed me in
And I’ve been fighting battles no one else has ever seen

I didn’t choose this aching, didn’t choose this endless war
Didn’t choose to stand outside while everyone shuts the door
I only wanted something simple, something others take for free
To look into the world and have it looking back at me

I’m tired of pretending I can carry all this weight
Tired of acting stronger while I slowly break

Why do I have to beg to just exist
Why can’t they simply see the girl that lives in this
Why does my heart have to scream just to be believed
Why does the world keep taking away the right to just be me

I don’t want your war, I don’t want your blame
I just want to be seen as the girl I’ve always been

They say there’s good people, I know that must be true
But good gets drowned by voices that keep tearing straight through
Every cruel opinion cuts a little deeper still
Till survival starts to feel less like living than a drill

I don’t want to be a lesson, don’t want to be debate
Don’t want strangers thinking they should get to choose my fate
I don’t want to be reduced to words they throw around
I just want to feel like I belong here on this ground

I want to wake up, look inside, and finally feel at peace
Not question every mirror, begging all the hurt to cease
I don’t want to only survive while everyone decides
If I deserve the right to live the truth I hold inside

I’m crying out from somewhere I don’t recognize
With shattered little prayers and swollen sleepless eyes
If there’s a place where I can breathe, then tell me where to run
Cause I can’t keep calling this a life when all I do is come undone

I don’t want to be seen as pain
Don’t want to be seen as some debate
I just want to be her in every space
And not feel fear written across my face

Why does kindness feel so far away
Why does hatred always get the loudest things to say
Why do I have to prove my soul is real

Why can’t the world just let me be the girl I already feel
I don’t need everyone to understand every scar
I just need one place where I can be exactly who I am

let me be the girl inside
let me be the girl inside

title: Searching For You
description: A song about searching for your love whoever that may be someones out there
lyrics:
Where have you gone
Where are you now
I'm looking for answers
That may never come

I'm looking far
And looking near
I want to see you
Standing right here

I'll travel far and I'll search so wide
In hopes to see you standing by my side
I don't know if you're real
But I know what I feel

So if you are out there
I'll be waiting right here

The stars above
Still shine so bright
I wonder if you
See the same tonight

Though time moves on
My hope stays clear
One day I'll find you
And hold you near

Every new face is a chance to see
If you're the one who's been missing from me
I've waited so long
For a place to belong

Maybe you're searching too
For a heart that is true

I'll cross every ocean
Ascend every hill
Chasing the feeling
That lingers still

Somewhere out there
Our paths will align
And all of this searching
Will lead you to mine

Maybe tomorrow
Maybe next year
Maybe you'll find me
And make it all clear

All of this longing
All of this time
Will finally lead me
To your hand in mine

So if you can hear me
Wherever you are
I'll keep searching for you
No matter how far

title: This Is Our Pride
description: A song about Pride Always be you
lyrics:
This is our pride
Burning through the darkest night
We are still alive

They told us we were shadows
They told us not to speak
Tried to turn our colors
Into something small and weak

But every scar's a story
Every tear became a flame
And no matter what they call us
We still know our names

This is our pride
Standing in the light
After every battle
After every fight

We were never broken
We were born to shine
This is our moment
This is our pride

To every trans girl dreaming
To every trans boy too
To every soul still searching
For a way to make it through

To every gay and lesbian
To every bi heart strong
You deserve a future
You deserve to belong

This is our pride
Rising with the dawn
Even when the cold winds
Tell us to move on

We are still standing
Still reaching for the sky
With love beside us
This is our pride

When the world feels heavy
And hope is hard to find
Take my hand beside you
Leave the fear behind

You are not a burden
You are not alone
There's a place that's waiting
A place to call your home

This is our pride
Louder than before
Every heart united
Opening the door

Trans and gay and lesbian
Bi and so much more
We will keep on rising
Like waves against the shore

No matter who you are
No matter where you hide
You deserve your future
You deserve your pride

This is our pride
And we'll carry it
Through the night
Until the morning light

title: Back In Time
description: A song about reflecting on the past and wishing to go back in time to change things. It explores themes of regret, nostalgia, and the desire for a second chance.
lyrics:
If I saw her before she knew
The girl inside would soon be true

I walk a mile every day
Wondering why it is this way
Every thought returns to you
The girl I never let shine through

Id go back to make it right 
To help her win her inner fight

I see her standing in the light
The life I hid just out of sight
Every step I took away
Left the truth I couldn't say

IF I COULD TAKE ME BACK IN TIME
ID BE THE GIRL THAT WAS INSIDE
BODY MIND AND SOUL ALINE 
ID HAVE BEEN THE GIRL ALL THIS TIME

But time moves on and won’t rewind
The past is carved inside my mind
Still every step I take today
Brings her a little more my way

If I saw her before she knew
The girl inside would soon be true
Id go back to make it right 
To help her win her inner fight

IF I COULD TAKE ME BACK IN TIME
ID BE THE GIRL THAT WAS INSIDE
BODY MIND AND SOUL ALINE 
ID HAVE BEEN THE GIRL ALL THIS TIME

I hear the echoes of her voice
A quiet dream without a choice
She waited deep beneath the skin
For years I never let her in

I tried to bury what was true
Pretending I just saw it wrong
But every mirror held the proof
The girl was there my whole life long

I walked through days I couldn't claim
Living inside a borrowed name
But every step I take tonight
Feels closer to a truer light

The past may live inside my mind
But now I know what I must be
The girl I hid for all that time
Is finally waking up in me

No more hiding in the dark
No more tearing me apart
All the years I pushed away
End right here, right now, today

Hear me rising from the pain
I won’t bury her again
Every truth I tried to hide
Now stands screaming from inside

I can’t return to yesterday
The road behind won’t fade away
But I can stand here in the light
And help someone else win their fight

If she’s afraid to speak her name
I’ll show her she’s not wrong to change
The past may be my silent scar
But I’ll make sure she goes farther

title: Becomming Her
description: A song about self-discovery and empowerment. It celebrates the journey of becoming the best version of oneself.
lyrics:
She lived beneath a painted sky
A girl who learned to laugh and lie
The mirror whispered soft and cold
“You’re not the one you wish to hold”

She wore the name they gave with pride
But something in her broke inside
Each breath she took, each smile she made
Felt like a dream that slowly frayed

She prayed at night to feel the same
To fit the skin that wore her name
But every prayer returned in flame
An echo calling through the pain

“This isn’t me,” her heart would cry
“I need to live before I die”
The silence answered cold and bare
Her broken voice hung in the air

But deep inside a spark still burned
Through every scar and every hurt
“I am the girl you cannot kill
I breathe, I burn, I always will”

The world grew sharp, the voices cruel
Her tears became a quiet fuel
She bit her tongue, she held her breath
And danced too close to thoughts of death

Yet somewhere in the dark remained
A stubborn truth that still proclaimed
“Stand up and fight through all the fear
The girl you are is already here”

She faced the mirror once again
Through every scar and every pain
The lies she wore began to fall
The truth inside outshined them all

“This isn’t me,” her heart would cry
“I need to live before I die”
The silence cracked beneath her voice
At last she knew she had a choice

And deep inside that fire burned
Through all she lost and all she learned
“I am the girl you cannot kill
I breathe, I burn, I always will”

She rose from scars the world had drawn
A phoenix wrapped in blood and dawn
Her heart still cracked, her voice still raw
But she became her truest law

She whispered to the glass one night
“You don’t control my life or fight”
Then tore away the lies she’d worn
And from the pain a girl was born

Now this is me, she stands and cries
No longer trapped beneath the lies
The storm still lives inside her chest
But now it roars instead of rests

The fire inside will never fade
Through every scar the world once made
“I am the girl you cannot kill
I breathe, I burn, I always will”

Now calm returns but not the same
The storm no longer burns in flame
She stands where once her silence bled
Alive, reborn, no longer dead

title: Before Its Too Late
description: A song following a very real concept around Trans Suicide
lyrics:
She used to run through open fields
Laughing loud, no wounds concealed
No one told her who to be
Back when life felt wild and free

But mirrors started twisting truth
Showing someone she outgrew
Every day she played along
Smiling through a quiet wrong

If you see someone alone tonight
Don’t just pass them in the light
Say their name, ask if they're okay
Small words can change a day

Hold a hand before it’s late
Help them carry all that weight
One small spark, one simple start
Can pull someone back from the dark

She learned the lines, she knew the role
Built a mask to hide her soul
Walked through halls like she belonged
While the nights kept stretching long

Changed her hair and changed her name
Tiny steps against the pain
Little fires in the gray
Trying just to find a way

If you see someone alone tonight
Don’t just pass them in the light
Say their name, ask if they're okay
Small words can change a day

Hold a hand before it’s late
Help them carry all that weight
One small spark, one simple start
Can pull someone back from the dark

One night silence filled the room
Heavy like a coming storm
No one heard the quiet break
No one saw the choice she’d make

Now the halls still hold her trace
Memories time can’t erase
And the story left behind
Is a warning for our kind

Maybe kindness
Maybe care
Could have told her someone’s there

Maybe one voice
Through the pain
Could have helped her try again

If you see someone alone tonight
Be the reason they still fight
Say their name and let them stay
Help them see another day

Every heart desires a spark
Every soul desires the dark
To be broken, then restart
Before they disappear apart

title: This Is Good Bye
description: A good bye to my father nothing more to say about it
lyrics:
No matter the pain that may make us cry
Im sorry to say that this is good bye

I loved the little things you did, I know you tried
But every act of kindness had a thorn inside
I liked that you respected me and said my name
But you stood beside the ones who left me in the flames

You said you cared for me, but care should not excuse
The people who kept leaving me with open wounds
So even if the good still shines the way it should
The bad burned brighter than the good ever could

I know your hurting i am to
I only wish we could stay true
I know this grief will pass in time
Im sorry to say this is good bye

I held on longer than I should
I tried to find the missing good
But some wounds never tell a lie
The hurt is real so this is goodbye

I reached for you when I was breaking down
But all your anger did was teach me how to drown
I needed dad, not someone cold behind a wall
You told me “get help” while you never helped at all

I watched your bad days like a storm I had to hide
While all my pain was pushed and buried to the side
I begged for comfort, but you left me asking why
You never held me, so I learned to say goodbye

This is goodbye
I know in time
You will see why
I had to fight

To stay alive
I had to cry
I had to try
So this is goodbye

There’s nothing left for us to mend
I can’t keep breaking just to bend
I wanted love, I needed light
But I was lonely every night

I hope one day you understand
Why I let go of your hand
I have to live, I have to fly
The hurt is real, so this is goodbye

title: Land Beyond

lyrics:

title: could have saved me
description: about wondering if i could have been saved had i been able to be me sooner
lyrics:
What if I had found myself before the world found me?
Before the silence built a prison no one else could see.
Would I have learned to love the girl I always knew I'd be?
Would hope have had a chance before it slipped away from me?

I keep reaching through the years,
Trying to touch forgotten dreams.
I can't stop wondering...

Why couldn't I have started younger?
Why couldn't I become that girl back then?
Maybe I would've found the courage
To open up and let somebody in.

Maybe laughter would've filled the empty spaces,
Maybe lonely nights would've been less cold.
Maybe I would've carried lighter burdens,
Instead of watching all that weight take hold.

I wonder if the road would've been different,
If my heart had finally felt at home.
Not a promise written into history,
Just another path I'll never know.

So many moments tied together,
Threads that never came undone.
Sometimes one beginning
Changes everything that follows.

What if I had found myself before the world found me?
Before the silence built a prison no one else could see.
Would I have learned to love the girl I always knew I'd be?
Would hope have had a chance before it slipped away from me?

I keep reaching through the years,
Trying to touch forgotten dreams.
I can't stop wondering...
Could it have saved me?
Could it have saved me?

The isolation echoed louder,
Every season felt the same.
Searching for a place to belong
While forgetting how to say my name.

Maybe I never would've fallen
Into a battle with myself.
Maybe my body would've carried
Less of the damage that I felt.

These last few years of living honestly,
A gift I'll never throw away.
But some scars were already written
Long before I found my way.

Still I don't hate the ones around me.
Even when the hurt runs deep.
I only wish the child I once was
Had been allowed her chance to breathe.

If I could whisper through the years,
I'd tell that little girl,
"You aren't broken.
You aren't pretending.
You aren't alone."

I'd tell her to hold on.
One day she'll hear her own name,
And it will sound like home.

But I can't rewrite yesterday.
I can't know who I might've been.
I only know
Some pieces were lost
Before I ever had the chance to find them.

Maybe things would've been different.
Maybe they wouldn't.
I'll never know.

But every child deserves the chance
To become themselves
Before the world teaches them
They're someone else.

What if I had found myself before the world found me?
Before the silence built a prison no one else could see.
I'll never know the life that waited
Just beyond those missing years,
But I'll always hear the question
Echoing through every tear.

Could I have laughed more?
Could I have loved more?
Could I have lived more?

I'll never know...

But I'll never stop wondering
If getting to be myself sooner
Could have saved me.

Could have saved me.
